references.text: Refers to the 'best' (chelev) of oil, wine, and grain given to the Lord, using the same terminology as in verse 29
Continuation of the instruction to give the best (chelev) as a vow offering
Context for the Levites' tithe and vow offering (terumah) to the Lord
Uses the same term 'terumah' (vow offering) in connection with holy gifts to the Lord
Describes the fat (chelev) that belongs to the Lord; the best must be given to Him
Refers to vow offerings (terumah) that are to be brought to the place the Lord chooses
Call to honor the Lord with the best of all produce, a parallel thought about giving the firstfruits
